docs: https://www.tradingview.com/charting-library-docs/latest/api/interfaces/Charting_Library.IChartingLibraryWidget, .../api/interfaces/Charting_Library.IChartWidgetApi, .../api/interfaces/Charting_Library.SubscribeEventsMap, .../api/interfaces/Charting_Library.IDatafeedChartApi, .../connecting_data/datafeed-api/required-methods, .../connecting_data/datafeed-api/trading-platform-methods, .../connecting_data/UDF, .../api/interfaces/Broker.IBrokerTerminal, .../api/interfaces/Broker.IBrokerConnectionAdapterHost (all under https://www.tradingview.com/charting-library-docs/latest/), read 2026-11. Names starting 'chart.' are IChartWidgetApi methods (activeChart().x / chart(i).x).

entries.name: onChartReady
entries.note: onReady(chart, widget) runs once in a microtask after new ChartWidget(). The widget is built synchronously: calls right after the constructor need no wait.

entries.name: chartReady
entries.note: No promise to await; the widget and widget.getChart() are usable as soon as the constructor returns.

entries.name: headerReady
entries.note: The toolbar is built in the constructor, so widget.addToolbarButton() works right away.

entries.name: activeChart
entries.note: Most activeChart().x calls go straight to the widget (setSymbol, setTimeframe) or to widget.getChart(). In a ChartWidgetGrid: grid.getActiveWidget().getChart().

entries.name: activeChartIndex
entries.note: Only for a ChartWidgetGrid; a single ChartWidget holds one chart.

entries.name: chart
entries.note: grid.getWidget(i) returns the ChartWidget (or null); its .getChart() is the Chart.

entries.name: chartsCount
entries.note: Take .length of the array.

entries.name: layout
entries.note: Layout names differ: '2x2', '1x2', '1+2'... (GridLayout), not '4', '2h', '3s'.

entries.name: setLayout
entries.note: Takes a GridLayout such as '2x2' or '1+2'; map each layout code by hand.

entries.name: layoutName
entries.note: The open saved layout's name is getLayoutSession()?.current()?.name; null when layouts are off.

entries.name: setSymbol
entries.note: Two async calls returning promises, no callback. Turn the resolution into a timeframe with resolutionToTimeframe('60') -> '1h'.

entries.name: symbolInterval
entries.note: The interval is a timeframe ('1h', '1d'), not a resolution; timeframeToResolution() converts back.

entries.name: changeTheme
entries.note: Synchronous, no promise. 'light' or 'dark', or a Theme object. widget.setUI() changes the widget's look (Studio, Terminal, Capsule, Desk).

entries.name: getTheme
entries.note: Returns the resolved Theme object, not its name.

entries.name: applyOverrides
entries.note: The keys are TradeCanvas style keys ('background.color', 'series.candlestick.upColor'), not paneProperties.*; see the override table.

entries.name: applyStudiesOverrides
entries.note: Per indicator id, with a style object; existing instances change with chart.updateIndicatorStyle(instanceId, style).

entries.name: applyTradingCustomization
entries.note: Colours of order and position lines are also style keys: trading.buyColor, trading.sellColor, trading.profitColor...

entries.name: addCustomCSSFile
entries.note: Not needed: the widget is in the page's DOM. Restyle it through its --tcw-* tokens or widget.setUI({...}).

entries.name: addCustomJSFile
entries.note: No equivalent; the widget runs in your page, so import your code as usual.

entries.name: areShortcutsEnabled
entries.note: Read .keyboard of the result.

entries.name: setShortcutsEnabled
entries.note: chart.setFeatures({ keyboard: false }); synchronous.

entries.name: onShortcut
entries.note: Spec { keys: 'Alt+N', label, onPress }; keys are a string, not key codes. Returns a handle with remove().

entries.name: clearUndoHistory
entries.note: No call to clear the undo history.

entries.name: undoRedoState
entries.note: Returns { canUndo, canRedo } only; chart.undo() and chart.redo() step it.

entries.name: closePopupsAndDialogs
entries.note: Closes the open dock panel only; menus and dialogs close on Escape or a click outside.

entries.name: createButton
entries.note: Spec needs id and label (icon, text, onClick...). Returns a handle { element, setActive, setText, remove }, or null when the toolbar is off.

entries.name: removeButton
entries.note: Call remove() on the handle addToolbarButton returned; there is no remove by id.

entries.name: createDropdown
entries.note: Synchronous; returns a handle (or null), not a promise.

entries.name: crosshairSync
entries.note: grid.setSync({ crosshair: true }); grid.getSync() reads it. Only in a ChartWidgetGrid.

entries.name: dateRangeSync
entries.note: grid.setSync({ time: true }).

entries.name: intervalSync
entries.note: grid.setSync({ interval: true }).

entries.name: symbolSync
entries.note: grid.setSync({ symbol: true }).

entries.name: timeSync
entries.note: grid.setSync({ time: true }).

entries.name: currencyAndUnitVisibility
entries.note: No currency or unit labels on the price scale.

entries.name: customSymbolStatus
entries.note: One status text in the legend; or widget.addStatusBarItem(spec) for an item of your own.

entries.name: customThemes
entries.note: setUI styles the widget (a preset or token values); chart.setTheme takes a Theme object for the chart itself.

entries.name: dateFormat
entries.note: A formatter function rather than a watched value.

entries.name: timeHoursFormat
entries.note: Write the 12/24 hour choice in your formatter.

entries.name: drawOnAllChartsEnabled
entries.note: No draw-on-all-charts mode; a grid can sync drawings with grid.setSync({ drawings: true }).

entries.name: startFullscreen
entries.note: One toggle for both ways.

entries.name: getCSSCustomPropertyValue
entries.note: The widget's look is --tcw-* tokens; getUI() returns the resolved values.

entries.name: setCSSCustomProperty
entries.note: Set --tcw-* token values through setUI rather than raw CSS variables.

entries.name: getIntervals
entries.note: No getter: the list is the timeframes option you passed.

entries.name: getLanguage
entries.note: No getter: the language is the locale option you passed.

entries.name: setLanguage
entries.note: Set at construction only; to switch at runtime, destroy and rebuild the widget with the new locale.

entries.name: getSavedCharts
entries.note: await widget.getLayoutSession()?.list(); where layouts live is the layouts.storage option (a LayoutStorage).

entries.name: loadChartFromServer
entries.note: Takes the saved layout's id; resolves to false when it is not found.

entries.name: saveChartToServer
entries.note: Saves through the LayoutStorage given in layouts.storage (default localStorage).

entries.name: removeChartFromServer
entries.note: await widget.getLayoutSession()?.remove(id).

entries.name: showSaveAsChartDialog
entries.note: No dialog call; getLayoutSession()?.saveAs(name) saves under a new name. The layouts toolbar button has the UI.

entries.name: showLoadChartDialog
entries.note: No call opens it; the layouts toolbar button does. List and open in code with getLayoutSession()?.list() and widget.openLayout(id).

entries.name: save
entries.note: Synchronous: a JSON string, or the object. The format is TradeCanvas's own; saved TradingView states do not load.

entries.name: load
entries.note: applyLayoutContent takes the string and resolves to false when it cannot read it.

entries.name: getStudiesList
entries.note: Returns descriptors with ids ('sma', 'rsi'), not display names.

entries.name: getStudyInputs
entries.note: Takes an indicator id; returns { id, params } with default params.

entries.name: getStudyStyles
entries.note: Per added instance, not per study name.

entries.name: hideAllDrawingTools
entries.note: Two calls instead of a watched boolean.

entries.name: lockAllDrawingTools
entries.note: Two calls instead of a watched boolean.

entries.name: magnetMode
entries.note: Modes are 'off', 'weak', 'strong', not numbers.

entries.name: mainSeriesPriceFormatter
entries.note: formatPrice returns the string the price axis would show.

entries.name: navigationButtonsVisibility
entries.note: A boolean option, not a watched value with modes.

entries.name: paneButtonsVisibility
entries.note: No setting for the pane buttons.

entries.name: news
entries.note: A function (symbol, limit) => Promise<NewsItem[]>; or the feed's fetchNews.

entries.name: onContextMenu
entries.note: A function of the menu context returning extra items; it adds after the built-in items. Times are ms.

entries.name: onGrayedObjectClicked
entries.note: Nothing is greyed out; tools and indicators are turned off with features instead.

entries.name: resetCache
entries.note: No bar cache to clear. With feedFromJsApi, the datafeed calling onResetCacheNeeded makes the chart load the series again.

entries.name: resetLayoutSizes
entries.note: No call to reset a grid's cell sizes.

entries.name: setLayoutSizes
entries.note: No call to size a grid's cells.

entries.name: selectLineTool
entries.note: Synchronous. Drawing types are camelCase ('trendLine'); null ends drawing. See the drawings table for names.

entries.name: selectedLineTool
entries.note: Null when not drawing.

entries.name: setDebugMode
entries.note: No debug logging switch.

entries.name: showNoticeDialog
entries.note: A toast, not a modal dialog; no promise.

entries.name: showConfirmDialog
entries.note: No confirm dialog; use your own.

entries.name: supportedChartTypes
entries.note: Chart types are names ('candlestick', 'heikinAshi'), not numbers.

entries.name: takeClientScreenshot
entries.note: Returns a PNG Blob (async) or a data URL (sync), not a canvas.

entries.name: takeScreenshot
entries.note: Downloads or copies the image; nothing is uploaded to a server.

entries.name: unloadUnusedCharts
entries.note: No equivalent.

entries.name: watchList
entries.note: Synchronous methods on the widget; getWatchlists() reads them.

entries.name: widgetbar
entries.note: Panels: 'watchlist', 'alerts', 'objectTree', 'dataWindow', 'symbolInfo', 'depthLadder'.

entries.name: subscribe
entries.note: Events are on the Chart (widget.getChart().on), with camelCase names; the handler gets { type, timestamp, payload }.

entries.name: subscribe:activeChartChanged
entries.note: Called with (index, widget).

entries.name: subscribe:add_compare
entries.note: payload.change is 'add', 'remove', 'data' or 'visible'.

entries.name: subscribe:compare_add
entries.note: No event for the compare dialog opening.

entries.name: subscribe:chart_load_requested
entries.note: No event before a layout loads; widget.applyLayoutContent() resolves when done.

entries.name: subscribe:chart_loaded
entries.note: For the first build. A layout loaded later: await widget.applyLayoutContent().

entries.name: subscribe:dragstart
entries.note: No drag events.

entries.name: subscribe:dragend
entries.note: No drag events; drawingUpdate fires after a drawing moves.

entries.name: subscribe:drawing_event
entries.note: One event per kind instead of one event with a type argument.

entries.name: subscribe:edit_object_dialog
entries.note: Closest: a double click on a drawing, which opens its settings.

entries.name: subscribe:indicators_dialog
entries.note: No event for the indicators dialog opening.

entries.name: subscribe:layout_about_to_be_changed
entries.note: No grid layout events.

entries.name: subscribe:layout_changed
entries.note: No grid layout events.

entries.name: subscribe:load_study_template
entries.note: No event for indicator templates.

entries.name: subscribe:mouse_down
entries.note: Only a click ({ x, y }) and barClick; no separate down and up.

entries.name: subscribe:mouse_up
entries.note: Only a click ({ x, y }) and barClick; no separate down and up.

entries.name: subscribe:onAutoSaveNeeded
entries.note: Fires often; debounce it. The widget's layouts can also auto-save by themselves (layouts.autoSave).

entries.name: subscribe:onMarkClick
entries.note: The payload holds every mark in the clicked badge (marks[]), not one id.

entries.name: subscribe:onTimescaleMarkClick
entries.note: TradeCanvas has one kind of mark (badges at the foot of the price pane).

entries.name: subscribe:onPlusClick
entries.note: Payload { price, x, y }.

entries.name: subscribe:onScreenshotReady
entries.note: Screenshots are not uploaded; chart.screenshotBlob() resolves with the image.

entries.name: subscribe:onSelectedLineToolChanged
entries.note: Payload { tool }, null when not drawing.

entries.name: subscribe:panes_order_changed
entries.note: payload.change is 'order' for a move.

entries.name: subscribe:undo
entries.note: One event for undo, redo and new steps: { canUndo, canRedo }.

entries.name: subscribe:reset_scales
entries.note: No event for a scale reset.

entries.name: subscribe:series_event
entries.note: No event for the main series' price scale changing.

entries.name: subscribe:study_event
entries.note: One event per kind instead of a type argument.

entries.name: subscribe:study_properties_changed
entries.note: payload.change says what: 'params', 'style', 'visible', 'pane'...

entries.name: subscribe:study_dialog_save_defaults
entries.note: No event for it.

entries.name: subscribe:timeframe_interval
entries.note: Closest: the visible range changing. Its from/to are bar indices, not times.

entries.name: subscribe:toggle_header
entries.note: No event; the toolbar is set by the toolbar option.

entries.name: subscribe:toggle_sidebar
entries.note: No event for the drawing sidebar.

entries.name: subscribe:widgetbar_visibility_changed
entries.note: No event; widget.getOpenPanel() reads which panel is open.

entries.name: chart.setSymbol
entries.note: On the widget, not activeChart(). Resolves void, not a boolean. A headless Chart with a stream uses switchStream.

entries.name: chart.setResolution
entries.note: Takes a timeframe ('1h'), not a resolution ('60'): resolutionToTimeframe() converts. Async.

entries.name: chart.resolution
entries.note: A timeframe ('1d'), not a resolution ('1D').

entries.name: chart.symbolExt
entries.note: Returns the SymbolInfo the feed resolved, or null.

entries.name: chart.createStudy
entries.note: Synchronous; returns the instance id or null. Takes an indicator id and params (see the study table), not a name and inputs.

entries.name: chart.getStudyById
entries.note: No study object; call chart methods with the instance id.

entries.name: chart.applyStudyTemplate
entries.note: Takes the list getIndicatorSetup() returned; the format is TradeCanvas's own.

entries.name: chart.removeEntity
entries.note: Separate calls for drawings and indicators.

entries.name: chart.createShape
entries.note: addDrawing({ type, anchors: [{ time, price }] }): time in ms, not seconds. Synchronous; returns the id or null.

entries.name: chart.createMultipointShape
entries.note: Same call with several anchors; each tool needs a set count (see the drawings table). Times in ms.

entries.name: chart.createAnchoredShape
entries.note: Use type 'anchoredText' or 'anchoredNote'. Its anchor is a time and price, not a percent of the pane.

entries.name: chart.getShapeById
entries.note: No shape object; call chart methods with the drawing id (setDrawingVisible, setDrawingLocked...).

entries.name: chart.getAllShapes
entries.note: Returns full DrawingState objects, not just id and name.

entries.name: chart.applyLineToolsState
entries.note: Takes TradeCanvas DrawingState[], synchronous.

entries.name: chart.reloadLineToolsFromServer
entries.note: Drawings are saved with the layout; reopen it with widget.openLayout(id).

entries.name: chart.bringToFront
entries.note: One drawing id per call.

entries.name: chart.availableZOrderOperations
entries.note: No query; moveDrawing returns false when the move does nothing.

entries.name: chart.shapesGroupController
entries.note: Plus ungroupDrawings, renameDrawingGroup, setDrawingGroupVisible/Locked, getDrawingGroups on the chart.

entries.name: chart.setVisibleRange
entries.note: Two numbers in ms, not { from, to } in seconds. Synchronous.

entries.name: chart.getVisibleRange
entries.note: Times in ms (the bars' unit), or null with no data.

entries.name: chart.getVisibleBarsRange
entries.note: Times of the first and last bars on screen, in ms.

entries.name: chart.canZoomOut
entries.note: No query.

entries.name: chart.setScrollEnabled
entries.note: chart.setFeatures({ panning: enabled }).

entries.name: chart.setZoomEnabled
entries.note: chart.setFeatures({ zooming: enabled }).

entries.name: chart.setChartType
entries.note: Takes a name ('candlestick', 'line', 'heikinAshi'), not a number. Synchronous.

entries.name: chart.chartType
entries.note: A name, not a number.

entries.name: chart.executeActionById
entries.note: No action ids; call the method instead: chart.undo(), chart.redo(), chart.fitContent(), widget.toggleFullscreen()...

entries.name: chart.getCheckableActionState
entries.note: No action ids; read state with the matching getter (isLogScale, isGridVisible...).

entries.name: chart.createOrderLine
entries.note: No line object: pass the whole set of TradingOrder. Drags and cancels come back as orderModify / orderCancel events (or an ExecutionAdapter).

entries.name: chart.createPositionLine
entries.note: The whole set of TradingPosition; close, reverse and bracket edits come back as events or through an ExecutionAdapter.

entries.name: chart.createExecutionShape
entries.note: A FillEvent { orderId, side, price, quantity, time (ms) }; needs trading on.

entries.name: chart.onIntervalChanged
entries.note: Payload { timeframe, previous }; or the widget's onTimeframeChange option.

entries.name: chart.onSymbolChanged
entries.note: Payload { symbol, previous }; symbolInfoChange carries the resolved SymbolInfo.

entries.name: chart.onDataLoaded
entries.note: payload.state is 'loading', 'loaded', 'end' or 'error'.

entries.name: chart.dataReady
entries.note: No promise; wait for state 'loaded'.

entries.name: chart.onVisibleRangeChanged
entries.note: from/to are bar indices; chart.getData()[i].time gives the time, or call chart.getVisibleTimeRange().

entries.name: chart.onHoveredSourceChanged
entries.note: No hover event for drawings or indicators.

entries.name: chart.crossHairMoved
entries.note: Payload has point, bar, time (ms) and indicatorValues.

entries.name: chart.exportData
entries.note: Synchronous; { range: 'all' | 'visible', indicators } in, { bars, columns } out. getExportText() gives CSV or JSON.

entries.name: chart.getEntityValues
entries.note: Values under the crosshair come in the crosshairMove payload; chart.getIndicatorOutput(instanceId) reads a whole series.

entries.name: chart.applyOverrides
entries.note: TradeCanvas style keys, not paneProperties.*; see the override table.

entries.name: chart.refreshMarks
entries.note: The chart does not pull marks; push the new set (ChartMark[], time in ms).

entries.name: chart.getPanes
entries.note: Plain data per pane (instanceId, indicators, rect), not pane objects.

entries.name: chart.getAllPanesHeight
entries.note: Read rect.height of each.

entries.name: chart.setAllPanesHeight
entries.note: One pane at a time, by an indicator instance id in it.

entries.name: chart.getTimezoneApi
entries.note: An IANA zone, minutes east of UTC, 'exchange', or null for the browser's.

entries.name: chart.getSeries
entries.note: No series object: use chart methods (setChartType, getData, setMainSeriesVisible, setPriceFormat).

entries.name: chart.getTimeScale
entries.note: No time scale object: use scrollTo, scrollToEnd, setVisibleRange, getVisibleTimeRange, fitContent on the chart.

entries.name: chart.barTimeToEndOfPeriod
entries.note: No helper; bar times are the bar's open, in ms.

entries.name: chart.endOfPeriodToBarTime
entries.note: No helper; bar times are the bar's open, in ms.

entries.name: chart.requestSelectBar
entries.note: No selection mode; listen for the next barClick yourself.

entries.name: chart.cancelSelectBar
entries.note: No selection mode; stop listening to barClick.

entries.name: chart.isSelectBarRequested
entries.note: No selection mode.

entries.name: chart.resetData
entries.note: No call; with feedFromJsApi the datafeed's onResetCacheNeeded reloads, or set the bars again with widget.setData().

entries.name: chart.loadChartTemplate
entries.note: No chart templates; layouts hold the full state (widget.applyLayoutContent).

entries.name: chart.marketStatus
entries.note: No watched market status; the symbol info panel shows it from SymbolInfo hours.

entries.name: chart.inactivityGaps
entries.note: No setting for inactivity gaps.

entries.name: chart.isMaximized
entries.note: No chart maximize in a grid; chart.getMaximizedPane() is about panes inside one chart.

entries.name: chart.maximizeChart
entries.note: No chart maximize in a grid; grid.setLayout('1x1') shows one.

entries.name: chart.restoreChart
entries.note: No chart maximize in a grid.

entries.name: chart.showPropertiesDialog
entries.note: No call opens a drawing's or indicator's settings dialog.

entries.name: chart.setDragExportEnabled
entries.note: No drag export.

entries.name: chart.getPriceToBarRatio
entries.note: No price-to-bar ratio.

entries.name: chart.setPriceToBarRatio
entries.note: No price-to-bar ratio.

entries.name: chart.setPriceToBarRatioLocked
entries.note: No price-to-bar ratio lock.

entries.name: onReady
entries.note: A TradeCanvas DataFeed has no onReady; its supportedTimeframes field replaces supported_resolutions. feedFromJsApi calls onReady for you.

entries.name: searchSymbols
entries.note: searchSymbols(query, options) returns Promise<SymbolInfo[]>, best first, instead of a callback with exchange and type arguments.

entries.name: resolveSymbol
entries.note: resolveSymbol(symbol) returns Promise<SymbolInfo | null>. pricescale/minmov become a price step; session strings become sessions (sessionsFromJsApi).

entries.name: getBars
entries.note: getBars({ symbol, timeframe, countBack, before, signal }) returns Promise<OHLCBar[]>, oldest first, times in ms. before replaces from/to in seconds.

entries.name: subscribeBars
entries.note: subscribeBars(request, subscriber) returns its own unsubscribe function; send bars with subscriber.bar(bar, closed). onResetCacheNeeded: feedFromJsApi reloads the series.

entries.name: unsubscribeBars
entries.note: No guid: call the function subscribeBars returned.

entries.name: getMarks
entries.note: The chart does not ask for marks; push ChartMark[] (time in ms, title required). Not read by feedFromJsApi.

entries.name: getTimescaleMarks
entries.note: One kind of mark (badges at the foot of the price pane); push them yourself, time in ms.

entries.name: getServerTime
entries.note: Not used; the bar countdown runs on the local clock.

entries.name: getVolumeProfileResolutionForPeriod
entries.note: Not used; volume profiles are built from the chart's own bars.

entries.name: getQuotes
entries.note: No one-shot request: quotes are subscribed, or pushed with widget.setQuotes. feedFromJsApi uses getQuotes for a first answer.

entries.name: subscribeQuotes
entries.note: subscribeQuotes(symbols, onQuotes) returns an unsubscribe function; no fastSymbols list, no guid.

entries.name: unsubscribeQuotes
entries.note: Call the function subscribeQuotes returned.

entries.name: subscribeDepth
entries.note: A DataFeed has no depth member: push each DepthData with setDepth. The ladder needs depthLadder: true.

entries.name: unsubscribeDepth
entries.note: Stop pushing; widget.setDepth(null) clears it.

entries.name: udf:/config
entries.note: Read once by udfFeed; supported_resolutions become the feed's timeframes. Without /config it takes the UDF defaults.

entries.name: udf:/symbols
entries.note: Read by udfFeed for resolveSymbol.

entries.name: udf:/search
entries.note: Read by udfFeed for the symbol search when /config allows search.

entries.name: udf:/symbol_info
entries.note: Group requests are not read; udfFeed still charts a symbol by its name when /symbols is missing. Serve /symbols for price steps.

entries.name: udf:/history
entries.note: Read by udfFeed: t in seconds becomes ms. UDF has no push, so live bars are asked for again every updateFrequency ms (default 10000).

entries.name: udf:/quotes
entries.note: Read by udfFeed for subscribeQuotes, polled every updateFrequency ms.

entries.name: udf:/marks
entries.note: Not read by udfFeed; fetch marks yourself and push them with chart.setMarks (time in ms).

entries.name: udf:/timescale_marks
entries.note: Not read by udfFeed; push them with chart.setMarks (time in ms).

entries.name: udf:/time
entries.note: Not read; there is no server time.

entries.name: placeOrder
entries.note: Takes an OrderPlaceIntent with no symbol: orders are taken to be for the chart's active symbol. Resolves with the TradingOrder.

entries.name: modifyOrder
entries.note: Only a re-price: { orderId, newPrice }. Quantity and brackets of a working order cannot be edited.

entries.name: cancelOrder
entries.note: Takes { orderId }.

entries.name: cancelOrders
entries.note: No batch cancel; call cancelOrder for each.

entries.name: closePosition
entries.note: Takes { positionId }; always a full close, no amount.

entries.name: closeIndividualPosition
entries.note: No individual positions; one position per id, closed in full.

entries.name: reversePosition
entries.note: Optional; without it the chart closes the position and places a market order the other way.

entries.name: editPositionBrackets
entries.note: Takes { positionId, stopLoss, takeProfit, trailingStop }; null removes one. No custom fields.

entries.name: editIndividualPositionBrackets
entries.note: No individual positions.

entries.name: orders
entries.note: Not pulled: the adapter emits an 'orders' event with the whole set (or the host calls chart.setOrders). Active symbol only.

entries.name: positions
entries.note: Not pulled: the adapter emits a 'positions' event with the whole set. Active symbol only.

entries.name: executions
entries.note: The adapter emits a 'fill' event per FillEvent (time in ms); chart.getFills() lists them.

entries.name: ordersHistory
entries.note: No order history; chart.getFills() lists the fills so far.

entries.name: individualPositions
entries.note: No individual positions.

entries.name: accountsMetainfo
entries.note: One account per adapter, named in connect({ account }); no account list or switcher.

entries.name: currentAccount
entries.note: The account given to connect({ account }).

entries.name: setCurrentAccount
entries.note: Disconnect and connect again with another account.

entries.name: accountManagerInfo
entries.note: The account panel's columns are fixed (positions, orders, fills); no custom pages or summary fields.

entries.name: chartContextMenuActions
entries.note: Your items are added after the built-in trade items.

entries.name: connectionStatus
entries.note: Returns a ConnectionState string, not a number.

entries.name: isTradable
entries.note: No per-symbol check; turn trading off with chart.setFeatures({ trading: false }) for symbols you cannot trade.

entries.name: symbolInfo
entries.note: No instrument info for trading: quantities are not checked against steps. The price step comes from SymbolInfo (DataFeed.resolveSymbol).

entries.name: formatter
entries.note: One price format for the chart, not per symbol.

entries.name: quantityFormatter
entries.note: No quantity formatter.

entries.name: spreadFormatter
entries.note: No spread formatter.

entries.name: getOrderDialogOptions
entries.note: The order ticket has no custom fields.

entries.name: getPositionDialogOptions
entries.note: No custom position dialog.

entries.name: getSymbolSpecificTradingOptions
entries.note: No per-symbol trading options.

entries.name: previewOrder
entries.note: No order preview.

entries.name: leverageInfo
entries.note: No leverage support.

entries.name: setLeverage
entries.note: No leverage support.

entries.name: previewLeverage
entries.note: No leverage support.

entries.name: subscribeEquity
entries.note: No equity display.

entries.name: unsubscribeEquity
entries.note: No equity display.

entries.name: subscribeMarginAvailable
entries.note: No margin display.

entries.name: unsubscribeMarginAvailable
entries.note: No margin display.

entries.name: subscribePipValue
entries.note: No pip values.

entries.name: unsubscribePipValue
entries.note: No pip values.

entries.name: orderUpdate
entries.note: Host call. Send the whole set of working orders, not one changed order: an 'orders' event from the adapter, or chart.setOrders.

entries.name: orderPartialUpdate
entries.note: Host call. Send the whole set again with the change.

entries.name: ordersFullUpdate
